description: This file defines the EmployeeImmigrationController class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the PIM plugin. It manages the pre-render setup for the employee immigration view, including setting up Vue components with employee data and permissions.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling the pre-render logic of the employee immigration view, including setting Vue component properties and permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the employee immigration component with employee number and country data, and sets permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data groups required for capability permission checking.
